verified: Strands Labs' own announcement says Strands Decider v2 is a family of five decision models built on Gemma 4, spanning 2B to 31B parameters under Apache 2.0, with weights published on Hugging Face and v2 support in the open-source Strands Decider repository; the models do not generate text but pick from a supplied list of options, returning a probability for each in a single forward pass, and VentureBeat independently describes the release the same way. The New Stack dates the launch to "Monday," consistent with third-party coverage placing it on Nov 23, 2026.
unconfirmed: the accuracy and calibration of the returned probabilities at each model size rest so far on the vendor's description, with no independent benchmark supplied; throughput, latency and how the five sizes compare in real agent-routing workloads are also unverified, and the item offers no detail on what changed from the earlier Strands Labs release seven weeks prior.

verified: Strands Labs 的博客（tool-3-1）称 Strands Decider v2 是基于 Gemma 4 的五个模型，参数规模从 E2B 到 31B，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，模型权重已发布在 Hugging Face，v2 支持已进入开源的 Strands Decider 仓库；VentureBeat（tool-3-2）和 explainx.ai（tool-3-3）的报道与这一描述一致。据该博客所述，Decider 属于“system one”模型：它不生成文本，而是在一次前向传播中从给定选项里选择，并为每个选项返回一个概率。
unconfirmed: 模型的决策准确率、概率校准质量与延迟等性能主张目前仅出自公司自己的博客，没有独立评测或第三方复现；各尺寸模型的具体硬件要求、是否通过 AWS 托管服务提供以及定价，均未在报道中说明。

titles.en: AWS launches five open Strands Decider v2 models, The New Stack reports
titles.zh: AWS 推出 Strands Decider v2：五个基于 Gemma 4 的开放决策模型
